question: In the United States, for Q4 2019 and Q4 2020, first select only those cities where total sales (with no promotions) rose by at least 20% from Q4 2019 to Q4 2020. Among these cities, rank products by their overall sales (still excluding promotions) in those quarters and take the top 20%. Then compute each top product’s share of total sales in Q4 2019 and Q4 2020 and calculate the difference in share from Q4 2019 to Q4 2020, returning the results in descending order of that share change.
sql:
WITH city_sales AS (
    SELECT c.cust_city, 
           t.calendar_year,
           SUM(s.amount_sold) as total_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'United States of America'
      AND s.promo_id = 999
      AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)
      AND t.calendar_quarter_number = 4
    GROUP BY c.cust_city, t.calendar_year
),
qualifying_cities AS (
    SELECT q2019.cust_city
    FROM city_sales q2019
    JOIN city_sales q2020 ON q2019.cust_city = q2020.cust_city
    WHERE q2019.calendar_year = 2019
      AND q2020.calendar_year = 2020
      AND q2020.total_sales >= 1.20 * q2019.total_sales
),
product_sales AS (
    SELECT s.prod_id,
           t.calendar_year,
           SUM(s.amount_sold) as product_total_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'United States of America'
      AND s.promo_id = 999
      AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)
      AND t.calendar_quarter_number = 4
      AND c.cust_city IN (SELECT cust_city FROM qualifying_cities)
    GROUP BY s.prod_id, t.calendar_year
),
product_ranking AS (
    SELECT prod_id,
           SUM(product_total_sales) as overall_sales,
           NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY SUM(product_total_sales) DESC) as tile
    FROM product_sales
    GROUP BY prod_id
),
top_products AS (
    SELECT prod_id
    FROM product_ranking
    WHERE tile = 1
),
quarter_totals AS (
    SELECT t.calendar_year,
           SUM(s.amount_sold) as total_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'United States of America'
      AND s.promo_id = 999
      AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)
      AND t.calendar_quarter_number = 4
      AND c.cust_city IN (SELECT cust_city FROM qualifying_cities)
    GROUP BY t.calendar_year
),
product_shares AS (
    SELECT ps.prod_id,
           ps.calendar_year,
           1.0 * ps.product_total_sales / qt.total_sales as share
    FROM product_sales ps
    JOIN top_products tp ON ps.prod_id = tp.prod_id
    JOIN quarter_totals qt ON ps.calendar_year = qt.calendar_year
),
shares_pivot AS (
    SELECT 
        prod_id,
        MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_year = 2019 THEN share ELSE NULL END) as share_2019,
        MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_year = 2020 THEN share ELSE NULL END) as share_2020
    FROM product_shares
    GROUP BY prod_id
)
SELECT 
    prod_id,
    share_2019,
    share_2020,
    share_2020 - share_2019 as share_change
FROM shares_pivot
ORDER BY share_change DESC
